component: Message view URI and junk classification

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: GetURIForViewIndex clears the result and returns success for none, out-of-range or dummy indices and for an absent folder. The junk consumer now finds or skips rows by checking that URI value. Usable rows still forward the folder URI-generation result, so the change does not make all backend errors impossible. The first-selected helper also retains its null output-pointer guard; only the checked callers pass known valid local addresses. No runtime junk or crash result is established.
title: Invalid view rows return an empty URI before folder lookup
